opening.argument: The price discussion is anchored in chart levels and conditional scenarios, not a promised return. He limits his own proposed UAI investment to $20 to $30 and makes any return conditional. He also warns against investing if UAI breaks the identified trend line and levels. His warning to select the right SIREN token address addresses a trading risk. Taken together, these are speculative market comments with stated limits and cautions, not a deceptive solicitation or a claim that gains are assured.
